kill.text: Price below $55: re-test growth and regulatory assumptions
Net deposits below $30B on a trailing 12-month basis (now $71B)
Regulatory action against prediction markets (event contracts are now ~12% of revenue)
Funded customers decline for two quarters

tam.market: US and international retail brokerage, wealth, crypto, prediction markets and consumer banking
tam.source: ValueInvestor estimate: US retail brokerage and wealth revenue pool ~$150B (Schwab, Fidelity, Vanguard, IBKR, Coinbase revenues) plus ~$20B international and event contracts.
tam.why_share: Robinhood revenue ~$5.6B annualised is ~3% of the pool; assets $396B (+19%) and net deposits $71B a year support ~7% by 2031.
tam.what_must_go_right: Asset gathering continues at ~20% a year; prediction markets survive regulation; net margin ~38%.

sections.industry_map: Robinhood is a retail brokerage and financial app: stock and options trading, crypto (plus Bitstamp exchange), prediction markets (event contracts), Gold subscription, cash sweep, credit card, retirement and banking.
sections.size_growth: US retail brokerage and wealth is a multi-trillion-dollar asset pool shifting to younger, digital investors. Q3 2026 revenue $1.42B (+12%) with options +31%, equities +41%, crypto -55%, event contracts +6x (Robinhood Q3 release, Oct 2026). Highly cyclical with retail trading and crypto prices; net interest income falls as rates fall.
sections.structure: Competitors: Schwab, Fidelity, Interactive Brokers, Coinbase, Webull, Kalshi/Polymarket. Low switching costs; brand and product velocity matter.
sections.demand_supply: Strong asset inflows: platform assets $396B (+19%), net deposits $15.7B in Q3 and $71B over 12 months, plus more than $13B in October including $6B from the Dell family's Trump Accounts contribution. Crypto volumes falling sharply (notional -38%).
sections.industry_risks: (1) Retail trading downturn - medium/high; warning: options and equity volumes. (2) Crypto bear market - high now/medium; warning: crypto revenue. (3) Regulation of prediction markets and payment for order flow, especially with a Democrat Congress from 2027 - medium/high. (4) Falling rates cut net interest revenue (-9%) - high/medium.
sections.outlook: Near: earnings flat to down year on year (Q3 EPS -16%) as crypto halves. Mid: diversification (prediction markets, banking, retirement, international) supports 15-20% growth. Long: could become a full-service financial platform for the next generation.
sections.winners: Product velocity, low cost, brand with young investors, regulatory breadth, asset gathering.
sections.business: Transaction revenue $867M, net interest $415M, other $142M; Gold subscribers 5.2M (+34%); funded customers 28.7M (+7%); ARPU $200. Adjusted EBITDA $808M; adjusted EPS $0.60.
sections.right_to_win: Fastest product innovator in US retail finance with a cost base far below incumbents and the strongest brand among under-40s.
sections.moat: Narrow and emerging: brand and scale, but low switching costs. Trend: improving as assets and subscriptions grow.
sections.tam_competitors: ~3% of US retail brokerage assets vs Schwab's ~$10T. Competitors: Schwab, Fidelity, IBKR, Coinbase, Kalshi.
sections.management: Co-founder CEO Vlad Tenev; CFO Jason Warnick retiring, succession done. Buybacks $1.3B since Q3 2024 at ~$48 average. Insiders heavy net sellers ($178M over 6 months). Expense discipline good (2026 opex guide trimmed).
sections.financials: Revenue grew ~36% a year 2020-2025 (on the screen data basis); turned profitable 2024. Engine shows share count growth of 16.9% a year, inflated by IPO-era conversions; recent buybacks offset dilution. Cash $5.8B.
sections.company_risks: (1) Crypto and trading volumes - KPI: transaction revenue. (2) Regulatory - KPI: actions on event contracts or PFOF. (3) Net interest sensitivity - KPI: NII. (4) Concentration in retail speculation - KPI: options share of revenue.
sections.variant_view: The market values Robinhood as a fast-growing fintech platform at ~34x earnings; we see a high-quality asset gatherer, but earnings are still driven by cyclical speculation (options, crypto, prediction markets), so the price already discounts a lot of growth.
sections.valuation: Our value (owner earnings $2.4/share, 18% then 10%, 12% discount): low $35, base $61, high $95; price $81 is 33% above base. Street mean $129 (30 analysts). Peers: IBKR ~25x, SCHW ~18x. Required margin of safety 50% (early, cyclical) gives entry $30. Ming's cost $80.53 (flat): hold only as a smaller position; do not add.
sections.pillars: (1) Net deposits above $50B a year - breach below $30B. (2) Gold subscribers growing above 20% - breach below 10%. (3) Revenue growth above 15% - breach below 5%. (4) No adverse prediction-market regulation - breach: CFTC/Congress restrictions.
sections.catalysts_flow: Q4 2026 results (Feb 2027); crypto price trend; prediction-market regulation in the new Congress. Sellers: crypto-linked funds as crypto falls. Buyers: fintech growth funds on asset growth.
sections.premortem: (1) Crypto and options volumes collapse together. (2) Congress or the CFTC curbs event contracts. (3) Rate cuts shrink interest income faster than growth offsets.
